headline: Cardinals CB Will Johnson Suffers Potential Season-Ending Injury
summary: SEPTEMBER 23: Johnson is indeed expected to miss the entire season, per ESPN’s Jeremy Fowler, something that LaFleur seemed to confirm on Wednesday. “We’re bracing for the worst right there,” LaFleur said (via Cards Wire’s Howard Balzer). “I don’t know if that’s exactly the wording of it, but we’re not prepared to have him back.” […]

headline: Giants To Add QB After Jaxson Dart Injury; OLB Brian Burns To Miss Time
summary: The Giants are moving forward without starting quarterback Jaxson Dart, who is set to undergo knee surgery after tearing his meniscus and MCL in their Week 2 loss to the Rams. headline: 49ers place starting DT C.J. West on IR due to knee injury
summary: 49ers defensive tackle C.J. West, who is going to miss at least a chunk of the season with a bone chip in his knee that will require surgery, was placed on injured reserve Wednesday.

headline: Herbert shuts down leadership questions amid Chargers' 0-2 start
summary: Justin Herbert was uncharacteristically fiery when asked Wednesday about increased vocal leadership on the Chargers amid the team's 0-2 start.

headline: Seahawks' Macdonald apologizes to Broncos' Payton for comments
summary: Seahawks coach Mike Macdonald said Wednesday he called Broncos coach Sean Payton and apologized for comments he made in a published video that went viral Tuesday.

headline: Broncos RB Coleman doesn't practice; Dobbins, Harvey limited
summary: Broncos running backs J.K. Dobbins and RJ Harvey were limited in practice Wednesday, and Jonah Coleman did not practice. Nevertheless, coach Sean Payton said he thinks "we're going to be all right" at the position Sunday against the Rams.
